consumer: An external graphing tool reading the exported snapshot's avatar stored_kcal field to plot calorie history over time; it asks 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie value right now?', not a yes/no.
scope: The avatar's own single raw stored_kcal scalar - one character's authoritative value, not an inventory reach or map region.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) - its body writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() (the raw stored kcal) directly into the snapshot JSON, alongside but distinct from the derived get_kcal_percent() float.
divergence: If the export emitted get_kcal_percent() (or kcal reconstructed from that percent) instead of raw get_stored_kcal(), then for an avatar whose max-kcal ceiling is shifted from default (e.g. by a trait/mutation) at stored_kcal=55000, the percent-derived number would not equal 55000 - the graph would plot wrong absolute calories.
